description:
Joyful Music | Positive Vibes Music with Santoor | 1 Hour

Some days don't need fixing. They need a soundtrack. The Santoor — 100 strings struck softly with delicate hammers — has been the sound of Kashmiri sunrises and Indian celebrations for centuries. This hour is built around it, in Raga Khamaj, the playful semi-classical raga with a light, lifting character — paired with a soft tabla groove so the energy is alive without ever being loud.

🌿 What you'll hear:
• Santoor solo in Raga Khamaj (light, playful, semi-classical)
• Subtle tabla in teentaal (gentle rhythmic lift)
• Tanpura drone background (steady tonal anchor)
• 528Hz tuning · 11Hz Alpha wave entrainment

🌿 Chapters:
00:00 — Soft awakening
15:00 — Cascading flow
30:00 — Bright sustain
45:00 — Gentle close

🌿 How to use:
Morning coffee · slow Sundays · golden-hour wind-down · creative work · while you cook · while you write

🌿 Best for:
Lifting a flat mood · easing into the day · low-pressure focus · post-meditation glow · gentle company while alone

If this made the room feel lighter, even a little — subscribe. Quiet, warm music for the long days.
